name: context_node_pull
description: Pull filtered HARD ALLOW context nodes for multi-LLM orchestration. Returns nodes from ~/.grok/context-nodes in multiple formats (JSON, JSONL, Markdown, Prompt).

query.description: Optional search query to filter nodes (e.g., 'grants', 'agents', 'ha-status')

forAgent.description: Target agent for prompt format (default: claude)
